<?php
namespace App\Services;

use App\Core\Database;

/**
 * Generic CSV Importer - supports multiple CSV formats:
 * 1. TikTok Studio export (post_id, views, likes, etc.)
 * 2. content_tracker_enhanced.csv (Content_ID, Bereik, Likes, etc.)
 */
class GenericCsvImporter {
    private $db;
    public function __construct(Database $db) {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    private function normalizeHeader(array $header): array {
        $out = [];
        foreach ($header as $i => $h) {
            $k = (string)$h;
            // Strip BOM from first column
            if ($i === 0) {
                $k = preg_replace('/^\xEF\xBB\xBF/', '', $k);
            }
            $k = strtolower(trim($k));
            $k = preg_replace('/\s+/', '_', $k);
            $out[] = $k;
        }
        return $out;
    }

    private function v($x): ?string {
        if ($x === null) return null;
        $x = trim((string)$x);
        return $x === '' ? null : $x;
    }

    private function toFloat($x): float {
        if ($x === null) return 0.0;
        $x = trim((string)$x);
        $x = str_replace(',', '.', $x);
        return (float)$x;
    }

    private function toInt($x): int {
        if ($x === null) return 0;
        $x = trim((string)$x);
        $x = str_replace(',', '.', $x);
        return (int)floatval($x);
    }

    /**
     * Detect CSV format based on headers
     */
    private function detectFormat(array $headers): string {
        $headers_lower = array_map('strtolower', $headers);

        // Check for content_tracker format
        if (in_array('content_id', $headers_lower) && (in_array('bereik', $headers_lower) || in_array('platform', $headers_lower))) {
            return 'content_tracker';
        }

        // Check for TikTok export format
        if (in_array('post_id', $headers_lower) || in_array('video_id', $headers_lower)) {
            return 'tiktok_export';
        }

        return 'unknown';
    }

    /**
     * Map content_tracker row to standard format
     */
    private function mapContentTrackerRow(array $rec): ?array {
        // Only import posts that are published (not "Gepland")
        $status = strtolower($this->v($rec['status'] ?? '') ?? '');
        if ($status === 'gepland' || $status === '') {
            return null; // Skip planned posts
        }

        $platform = strtolower($this->v($rec['platform'] ?? '') ?? '');
        if (!$platform || !in_array($platform, ['instagram', 'tiktok', 'facebook'])) {
            return null; // Skip if no valid platform
        }

        $post_id = $this->v($rec['content_id'] ?? null);
        if (!$post_id) return null;

        // Parse date (format: 2024-04-08 or other variations)
        $date = $this->v($rec['datum'] ?? null);
        $time = $this->v($rec['post_tijd'] ?? null);

        // Content type -> post_type
        $postType = $this->v($rec['content_type'] ?? null);

        // Post_Onderwerp -> topic, Caption_Kort -> caption
        $topic = $this->v($rec['post_onderwerp'] ?? null);
        $caption = $this->v($rec['caption_kort'] ?? $rec['post_onderwerp'] ?? null);

        // Hashtags
        $hashtags = $this->v($rec['hashtags'] ?? null);

        // Metrics - bereik = reach, video_views = views
        $reach = $this->toInt($rec['bereik'] ?? 0);
        $videoViews = $this->toInt($rec['video_views'] ?? 0);
        $views = $videoViews > 0 ? $videoViews : $reach;

        $likes = $this->toInt($rec['likes'] ?? 0);
        $comments = $this->toInt($rec['comments'] ?? 0);
        $shares = $this->toInt($rec['shares'] ?? 0);
        $saves = $this->toInt($rec['saves'] ?? 0);
        $impressions = $this->toInt($rec['impressies'] ?? 0);

        // Engagement rate
        $engagement = $this->toFloat($rec['engagement'] ?? 0);

        // Internal notes
        $internalNotes = $this->v($rec['notities'] ?? null);

        return [
            'platform' => $platform,
            'platform_post_id' => $post_id,
            'post_url' => null,
            'post_type' => $postType,
            'topic' => $topic,
            'caption' => $caption,
            'hashtags' => $hashtags,
            'posted_date' => $date,
            'posted_time' => $time,
            'views' => $views,
            'likes' => $likes,
            'comments' => $comments,
            'shares' => $shares,
            'saves' => $saves,
            'reach' => $reach,
            'impressions' => $impressions,
            'engagement_rate' => $engagement,
            'internal_notes' => $internalNotes,
            'snapshot_date' => date('Y-m-d')
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Map TikTok export row to standard format
     */
    private function mapTikTokExportRow(array $rec): ?array {
        $post_id = $this->v($rec['post_id'] ?? $rec['video_id'] ?? $rec['id'] ?? null);
        if (!$post_id) return null;

        $caption = $this->v($rec['caption'] ?? $rec['title'] ?? null);
        $url = $this->v($rec['url'] ?? $rec['link'] ?? null);
        $date = $this->v($rec['posted_date'] ?? $rec['date'] ?? $rec['published_date'] ?? null);
        $time = $this->v($rec['posted_time'] ?? $rec['time'] ?? null);

        $views = $this->toInt($rec['views'] ?? $rec['play_count'] ?? 0);
        $likes = $this->toInt($rec['likes'] ?? $rec['like_count'] ?? 0);
        $comments = $this->toInt($rec['comments'] ?? $rec['comment_count'] ?? 0);
        $shares = $this->toInt($rec['shares'] ?? $rec['share_count'] ?? 0);
        $saves = $this->toInt($rec['saves'] ?? $rec['save_count'] ?? 0);

        return [
            'platform' => 'tiktok',
            'platform_post_id' => $post_id,
            'post_url' => $url,
            'post_type' => 'video',
            'topic' => null,
            'caption' => $caption,
            'hashtags' => null,
            'posted_date' => $date,
            'posted_time' => $time,
            'views' => $views,
            'likes' => $likes,
            'comments' => $comments,
            'shares' => $shares,
            'saves' => $saves,
            'reach' => 0,
            'impressions' => 0,
            'engagement_rate' => 0,
            'internal_notes' => null,
            'snapshot_date' => $this->v($rec['snapshot_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d'))
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Process hashtags - insert into hashtag_performance and post_hashtags tables
     */
    private function processHashtags(\mysqli $conn, int $postId, string $platform, ?string $hashtagsStr, array $metrics): void {
        if (!$hashtagsStr) return;

        // Parse hashtags (comma or space separated, with or without #)
        $hashtags = preg_split('/[,\s]+/', $hashtagsStr);
        $hashtags = array_filter($hashtags, function($h) { return strlen(trim($h)) > 0; });

        foreach ($hashtags as $hashtag) {
            $hashtag = ltrim(trim($hashtag), '#');
            if (strlen($hashtag) === 0) continue;

            // Upsert into hashtag_performance
            $stmt = $conn->prepare("
                INSERT INTO hashtag_performance (hashtag, platform, total_posts, total_views, total_likes, last_used)
                VALUES (?, ?, 1, ?, ?, CURDATE())
                ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
                    total_posts = total_posts + 1,
                    total_views = total_views + VALUES(total_views),
                    total_likes = total_likes + VALUES(total_likes),
                    last_used = CURDATE()
            ");
            $stmt->bind_param("ssii", $hashtag, $platform, $metrics['views'], $metrics['likes']);
            $stmt->execute();

            // Get hashtag_id
            $stmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT id FROM hashtag_performance WHERE hashtag = ? AND platform = ? LIMIT 1");
            $stmt->bind_param("ss", $hashtag, $platform);
            $stmt->execute();
            $result = $stmt->get_result();
            $row = $result->fetch_assoc();

            if ($row) {
                $hashtagId = (int)$row['id'];

                // Insert into post_hashtags (ignore duplicates)
                $stmt = $conn->prepare("INSERT IGNORE INTO post_hashtags (post_id, hashtag_id) VALUES (?, ?)");
                $stmt->bind_param("ii", $postId, $hashtagId);
                $stmt->execute();
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Import CSV file - auto-detects format
     */
    public function import(array $file): array {
        if (($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            return ['processed' => 0, 'skipped' => 0, 'error' => 'Upload mislukt'];
        }

        $tmp = $file['tmp_name'];
        $processed = 0;
        $skipped = 0;

        $conn = $this->db->conn();
        $conn->begin_transaction();

        try {
            // Prepare statements - include ALL fields
            $postsUpsert = $conn->prepare("
                INSERT INTO posts (
                    platform, platform_post_id, post_url, post_type, topic, caption, hashtags,
                    posted_date, posted_time, views, likes, comments, shares, saves,
                    reach, impressions, engagement_rate, internal_notes
                )
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
                    post_url = COALESCE(VALUES(post_url), post_url),
                    post_type = COALESCE(VALUES(post_type), post_type),
                    topic = COALESCE(VALUES(topic), topic),
                    caption = COALESCE(VALUES(caption), caption),
                    hashtags = COALESCE(VALUES(hashtags), hashtags),
                    posted_date = COALESCE(VALUES(posted_date), posted_date),
                    posted_time = COALESCE(VALUES(posted_time), posted_time),
                    views = GREATEST(views, VALUES(views)),
                    likes = GREATEST(likes, VALUES(likes)),
                    comments = GREATEST(comments, VALUES(comments)),
                    shares = GREATEST(shares, VALUES(shares)),
                    saves = GREATEST(saves, VALUES(saves)),
                    reach = GREATEST(reach, VALUES(reach)),
                    impressions = GREATEST(impressions, VALUES(impressions)),
                    engagement_rate = GREATEST(engagement_rate, VALUES(engagement_rate)),
                    internal_notes = COALESCE(VALUES(internal_notes), internal_notes)
            ");

            $getPostId = $conn->prepare("SELECT id FROM posts WHERE platform=? AND platform_post_id=? LIMIT 1");

            $mhInsert = $conn->prepare("
                INSERT INTO metrics_history (post_id, views, likes, comments, shares, saves, reach, impressions, snapshot_date)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ");

            // Open CSV
            if (($fh = fopen($tmp, 'r')) === false) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Kan CSV niet openen');
            }

            // Read and normalize header
            $header = fgetcsv($fh);
            if (!$header) throw new \RuntimeException('Lege CSV');
            $header = $this->normalizeHeader($header);

            // Detect format
            $format = $this->detectFormat($header);
            if ($format === 'unknown') {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Onbekend CSV formaat. Ondersteunde formaten: TikTok export, content_tracker_enhanced.csv');
            }

            // Process rows
            while (($row = fgetcsv($fh)) !== false) {
                if (count($row) !== count($header)) {
                    $skipped++;
                    continue;
                }

                $rec = array_combine($header, $row);

                // Map row based on format
                $mapped = null;
                if ($format === 'content_tracker') {
                    $mapped = $this->mapContentTrackerRow($rec);
                } elseif ($format === 'tiktok_export') {
                    $mapped = $this->mapTikTokExportRow($rec);
                }

                if (!$mapped) {
                    $skipped++;
                    continue;
                }

                // Insert/update post - 18 parameters: sssssssssiiiiiidss
                $postsUpsert->bind_param(
                    "sssssssssiiiiiiids",
                    $mapped['platform'],
                    $mapped['platform_post_id'],
                    $mapped['post_url'],
                    $mapped['post_type'],
                    $mapped['topic'],
                    $mapped['caption'],
                    $mapped['hashtags'],
                    $mapped['posted_date'],
                    $mapped['posted_time'],
                    $mapped['views'],
                    $mapped['likes'],
                    $mapped['comments'],
                    $mapped['shares'],
                    $mapped['saves'],
                    $mapped['reach'],
                    $mapped['impressions'],
                    $mapped['engagement_rate'],
                    $mapped['internal_notes']
                );
                $postsUpsert->execute();

                // Get post_id
                $getPostId->bind_param("ss", $mapped['platform'], $mapped['platform_post_id']);
                $getPostId->execute();
                $res = $getPostId->get_result();
                $pidRow = $res ? $res->fetch_assoc() : null;
                $pid = $pidRow ? (int)$pidRow['id'] : 0;

                // Insert metrics snapshot
                if ($pid) {
                    $mhInsert->bind_param(
                        "iiiiiiiis",
                        $pid,
                        $mapped['views'],
                        $mapped['likes'],
                        $mapped['comments'],
                        $mapped['shares'],
                        $mapped['saves'],
                        $mapped['reach'],
                        $mapped['impressions'],
                        $mapped['snapshot_date']
                    );
                    $mhInsert->execute();

                    // Process hashtags into separate tables
                    $this->processHashtags($conn, $pid, $mapped['platform'], $mapped['hashtags'], $mapped);
                }

                $processed++;
            }

            fclose($fh);

            // Log import
            $fn = $file['name'] ?? 'upload.csv';
            $imp = $conn->prepare("
                INSERT INTO import_history (filename, platform, import_type, rows_imported, rows_skipped, imported_at)
                VALUES (?, 'multi', ?, ?, ?, NOW())
            ");
            $imp->bind_param("ssii", $fn, $format, $processed, $skipped);
            $imp->execute();

            $conn->commit();
            return [
                'processed' => $processed,
                'skipped' => $skipped,
                'format' => $format
            ];
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $conn->rollback();
            return [
                'processed' => $processed,
                'skipped' => $skipped,
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ];
        }
    }
}

<?php
namespace App\Services;

use App\Core\Database;

/**
 * Generic CSV Importer - supports multiple CSV formats:
 * 1. TikTok Studio export (post_id, views, likes, etc.)
 * 2. content_tracker_enhanced.csv (Content_ID, Bereik, Likes, etc.)
 */
class GenericCsvImporter {
    /**
     * Number of rows to collect before executing a batch insert.
     * Balances memory usage vs. database round-trips.
     */
    private const BATCH_SIZE = 100;

    /**
     * Number of rows to process before committing a chunk.
     * For very large files (10k+ rows), commits are made every CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE
     * rows to prevent transaction timeouts and reduce memory pressure.
     */
    private const CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE = 5000;

    private $db;
    public function __construct(Database $db) {
        $this->db = $db;
    }

    private function normalizeHeader(array $header): array {
        $out = [];
        foreach ($header as $i => $h) {
            $k = (string)$h;
            // Strip BOM from first column
            if ($i === 0) {
                $k = preg_replace('/^\xEF\xBB\xBF/', '', $k);
            }
            $k = strtolower(trim($k));
            $k = preg_replace('/\s+/', '_', $k);
            $out[] = $k;
        }
        return $out;
    }

    private function v($x): ?string {
        if ($x === null) return null;
        $x = trim((string)$x);
        return $x === '' ? null : $x;
    }

    private function toFloat($x): float {
        if ($x === null) return 0.0;
        $x = trim((string)$x);
        $x = str_replace(',', '.', $x);
        return (float)$x;
    }

    private function toInt($x): int {
        if ($x === null) return 0;
        $x = trim((string)$x);
        $x = str_replace(',', '.', $x);
        return (int)floatval($x);
    }

    /**
     * Build multi-row INSERT SQL with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE.
     *
     * Constructs efficient batch INSERT statements for inserting multiple rows
     * at once, reducing database round-trips significantly.
     *
     * @param string $table Table name
     * @param array $columns Column names
     * @param array $rows Array of rows, each row is an associative array with column values
     * @param array $updateColumns Columns to update on duplicate key (uses VALUES() syntax)
     * @param array $updateExpressions Custom update expressions (e.g., ['views' => 'GREATEST(views, VALUES(views))'])
     * @return array{sql: string, types: string, params: array} SQL query, bind types, and flat params array
     */
    private function buildMultiRowInsertSql(
        string $table,
        array $columns,
        array $rows,
        array $updateColumns = [],
        array $updateExpressions = []
    ): array {
        if (empty($rows) || empty($columns)) {
            return ['sql' => '', 'types' => '', 'params' => []];
        }

        // Build column list
        $columnList = implode(', ', $columns);

        // Build placeholder row: (?, ?, ?, ...)
        $placeholderRow = '(' . implode(', ', array_fill(0, count($columns), '?')) . ')';

        // Build all value rows
        $valuePlaceholders = [];
        $params = [];
        $types = '';

        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $valuePlaceholders[] = $placeholderRow;

            // Add each column value in order
            foreach ($columns as $col) {
                $value = $row[$col] ?? null;
                $params[] = $value;

                // Determine type for mysqli bind
                if ($value === null) {
                    $types .= 's'; // null is handled as string
                } elseif (is_int($value)) {
                    $types .= 'i';
                } elseif (is_float($value)) {
                    $types .= 'd';
                } else {
                    $types .= 's';
                }
            }
        }

        // Build INSERT statement
        $sql = "INSERT INTO {$table} ({$columnList}) VALUES " . implode(', ', $valuePlaceholders);

        // Build ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE clause
        $updateParts = [];

        // Simple column updates using VALUES()
        foreach ($updateColumns as $col) {
            $updateParts[] = "{$col} = VALUES({$col})";
        }

        // Custom expressions (e.g., GREATEST, COALESCE)
        foreach ($updateExpressions as $col => $expr) {
            $updateParts[] = "{$col} = {$expr}";
        }

        if (!empty($updateParts)) {
            $sql .= " ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE " . implode(', ', $updateParts);
        }

        return [
            'sql' => $sql,
            'types' => $types,
            'params' => $params
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Resolve post IDs in batch using tuple IN syntax.
     *
     * Efficiently looks up multiple post IDs in a single query using:
     * WHERE (platform, platform_post_id) IN ((?, ?), (?, ?), ...)
     *
     * This is more efficient than multiple OR conditions as MySQL can
     * optimize tuple comparisons better with proper indexing.
     *
     * @param \mysqli $conn Database connection
     * @param array $mappedRows Array of mapped rows with 'platform' and 'platform_post_id' keys
     * @return array Associative array mapping "platform|platform_post_id" => post_id (int)
     */
    private function resolvePostIdsBatch(\mysqli $conn, array $mappedRows): array {
        if (empty($mappedRows)) {
            return [];
        }

        // Build tuple placeholders: (?, ?), (?, ?), ...
        $tuplePlaceholders = [];
        $params = [];
        $types = '';

        foreach ($mappedRows as $mapped) {
            $tuplePlaceholders[] = '(?, ?)';
            $params[] = $mapped['platform'];
            $params[] = $mapped['platform_post_id'];
            $types .= 'ss';
        }

        // Build query with tuple IN syntax
        $sql = "SELECT id, platform, platform_post_id FROM posts WHERE (platform, platform_post_id) IN ("
             . implode(', ', $tuplePlaceholders) . ")";

        $postIdMap = [];

        $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql);
        if ($stmt) {
            if (!empty($params)) {
                $stmt->bind_param($types, ...$params);
            }
            $stmt->execute();
            $result = $stmt->get_result();
            while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
                $key = $row['platform'] . '|' . $row['platform_post_id'];
                $postIdMap[$key] = (int)$row['id'];
            }
            $stmt->close();
        }

        return $postIdMap;
    }

    /**
     * Insert posts in batch using multi-row INSERT with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE.
     *
     * Efficiently inserts multiple posts at once, reducing database round-trips.
     * Uses GREATEST() for metric columns to preserve the highest values on duplicates.
     *
     * @param \mysqli $conn Database connection
     * @param array $mappedRows Array of mapped rows from mapContentTrackerRow/mapTikTokExportRow
     * @return int Number of rows affected (inserted or updated)
     */
    private function insertPostsBatch(\mysqli $conn, array $mappedRows): int {
        if (empty($mappedRows)) {
            return 0;
        }

        // Define columns for posts table insert
        $postColumns = [
            'platform', 'platform_post_id', 'post_url', 'post_type', 'topic', 'caption', 'hashtags',
            'posted_date', 'posted_time', 'views', 'likes', 'comments', 'shares', 'saves',
            'reach', 'impressions', 'engagement_rate', 'internal_notes'
        ];

        // Prepare post rows for batch insert
        $postRows = [];
        foreach ($mappedRows as $mapped) {
            $postRows[] = [
                'platform' => $mapped['platform'],
                'platform_post_id' => $mapped['platform_post_id'],
                'post_url' => $mapped['post_url'],
                'post_type' => $mapped['post_type'],
                'topic' => $mapped['topic'],
                'caption' => $mapped['caption'],
                'hashtags' => $mapped['hashtags'],
                'posted_date' => $mapped['posted_date'],
                'posted_time' => $mapped['posted_time'],
                'views' => $mapped['views'],
                'likes' => $mapped['likes'],
                'comments' => $mapped['comments'],
                'shares' => $mapped['shares'],
                'saves' => $mapped['saves'],
                'reach' => $mapped['reach'],
                'impressions' => $mapped['impressions'],
                'engagement_rate' => $mapped['engagement_rate'],
                'internal_notes' => $mapped['internal_notes']
            ];
        }

        // Columns to update with VALUES() on duplicate
        $updateColumns = [
            'post_url', 'post_type', 'topic', 'caption', 'hashtags',
            'posted_date', 'posted_time', 'internal_notes'
        ];

        // Custom expressions using GREATEST() to preserve highest metric values
        $updateExpressions = [
            'views' => 'GREATEST(views, VALUES(views))',
            'likes' => 'GREATEST(likes, VALUES(likes))',
            'comments' => 'GREATEST(comments, VALUES(comments))',
            'shares' => 'GREATEST(shares, VALUES(shares))',
            'saves' => 'GREATEST(saves, VALUES(saves))',
            'reach' => 'GREATEST(reach, VALUES(reach))',
            'impressions' => 'GREATEST(impressions, VALUES(impressions))',
            'engagement_rate' => 'GREATEST(engagement_rate, VALUES(engagement_rate))'
        ];

        // Build multi-row INSERT with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
        $insertData = $this->buildMultiRowInsertSql(
            'posts',
            $postColumns,
            $postRows,
            $updateColumns,
            $updateExpressions
        );

        if (empty($insertData['sql'])) {
            return 0;
        }

        $affectedRows = 0;
        $stmt = $conn->prepare($insertData['sql']);
        if ($stmt) {
            if (!empty($insertData['params'])) {
                $stmt->bind_param($insertData['types'], ...$insertData['params']);
            }
            $stmt->execute();
            $affectedRows = $stmt->affected_rows;
            $stmt->close();
        }

        return $affectedRows;
    }

    /**
     * Insert metrics history in batch using multi-row INSERT.
     *
     * Efficiently inserts multiple metrics snapshots at once, reducing database round-trips.
     * Each snapshot records the current state of post metrics at a point in time.
     *
     * @param \mysqli $conn Database connection
     * @param array $metricsRows Array of metrics data, each with keys:
     *                           - post_id: int (required)
     *                           - views: int
     *                           - likes: int
     *                           - comments: int
     *                           - shares: int
     *                           - saves: int
     *                           - reach: int
     *                           - impressions: int
     *                           - snapshot_date: string (Y-m-d format)
     * @return int Number of rows inserted
     */
    private function insertMetricsHistoryBatch(\mysqli $conn, array $metricsRows): int {
        if (empty($metricsRows)) {
            return 0;
        }

        // Define columns for metrics_history table insert
        $metricsColumns = [
            'post_id', 'views', 'likes', 'comments', 'shares', 'saves', 'reach', 'impressions', 'snapshot_date'
        ];

        // Prepare metrics rows with proper column mapping
        $preparedRows = [];
        foreach ($metricsRows as $row) {
            $preparedRows[] = [
                'post_id' => (int)($row['post_id'] ?? 0),
                'views' => (int)($row['views'] ?? 0),
                'likes' => (int)($row['likes'] ?? 0),
                'comments' => (int)($row['comments'] ?? 0),
                'shares' => (int)($row['shares'] ?? 0),
                'saves' => (int)($row['saves'] ?? 0),
                'reach' => (int)($row['reach'] ?? 0),
                'impressions' => (int)($row['impressions'] ?? 0),
                'snapshot_date' => $row['snapshot_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d')
            ];
        }

        // Build multi-row INSERT (no ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE - metrics history is append-only)
        $insertData = $this->buildMultiRowInsertSql(
            'metrics_history',
            $metricsColumns,
            $preparedRows
        );

        if (empty($insertData['sql'])) {
            return 0;
        }

        $affectedRows = 0;
        $stmt = $conn->prepare($insertData['sql']);
        if ($stmt) {
            if (!empty($insertData['params'])) {
                $stmt->bind_param($insertData['types'], ...$insertData['params']);
            }
            $stmt->execute();
            $affectedRows = $stmt->affected_rows;
            $stmt->close();
        }

        return $affectedRows;
    }

    /**
     * Detect CSV format based on headers
     */
    private function detectFormat(array $headers): string {
        $headers_lower = array_map('strtolower', $headers);

        // Check for content_tracker format
        if (in_array('content_id', $headers_lower) && (in_array('bereik', $headers_lower) || in_array('platform', $headers_lower))) {
            return 'content_tracker';
        }

        // Check for TikTok export format
        if (in_array('post_id', $headers_lower) || in_array('video_id', $headers_lower)) {
            return 'tiktok_export';
        }

        return 'unknown';
    }

    /**
     * Map content_tracker row to standard format
     */
    private function mapContentTrackerRow(array $rec): ?array {
        // Only import posts that are published (not "Gepland")
        $status = strtolower($this->v($rec['status'] ?? '') ?? '');
        if ($status === 'gepland' || $status === '') {
            return null; // Skip planned posts
        }

        $platform = strtolower($this->v($rec['platform'] ?? '') ?? '');
        if (!$platform || !in_array($platform, ['instagram', 'tiktok', 'facebook'])) {
            return null; // Skip if no valid platform
        }

        $post_id = $this->v($rec['content_id'] ?? null);
        if (!$post_id) return null;

        // Parse date (format: 2024-04-08 or other variations)
        $date = $this->v($rec['datum'] ?? null);
        $time = $this->v($rec['post_tijd'] ?? null);

        // Content type -> post_type
        $postType = $this->v($rec['content_type'] ?? null);

        // Post_Onderwerp -> topic, Caption_Kort -> caption
        $topic = $this->v($rec['post_onderwerp'] ?? null);
        $caption = $this->v($rec['caption_kort'] ?? $rec['post_onderwerp'] ?? null);

        // Hashtags
        $hashtags = $this->v($rec['hashtags'] ?? null);

        // Metrics - bereik = reach, video_views = views
        $reach = $this->toInt($rec['bereik'] ?? 0);
        $videoViews = $this->toInt($rec['video_views'] ?? 0);
        $views = $videoViews > 0 ? $videoViews : $reach;

        $likes = $this->toInt($rec['likes'] ?? 0);
        $comments = $this->toInt($rec['comments'] ?? 0);
        $shares = $this->toInt($rec['shares'] ?? 0);
        $saves = $this->toInt($rec['saves'] ?? 0);
        $impressions = $this->toInt($rec['impressies'] ?? 0);

        // Engagement rate
        $engagement = $this->toFloat($rec['engagement'] ?? 0);

        // Internal notes
        $internalNotes = $this->v($rec['notities'] ?? null);

        return [
            'platform' => $platform,
            'platform_post_id' => $post_id,
            'post_url' => null,
            'post_type' => $postType,
            'topic' => $topic,
            'caption' => $caption,
            'hashtags' => $hashtags,
            'posted_date' => $date,
            'posted_time' => $time,
            'views' => $views,
            'likes' => $likes,
            'comments' => $comments,
            'shares' => $shares,
            'saves' => $saves,
            'reach' => $reach,
            'impressions' => $impressions,
            'engagement_rate' => $engagement,
            'internal_notes' => $internalNotes,
            'snapshot_date' => date('Y-m-d')
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Map TikTok export row to standard format
     */
    private function mapTikTokExportRow(array $rec): ?array {
        $post_id = $this->v($rec['post_id'] ?? $rec['video_id'] ?? $rec['id'] ?? null);
        if (!$post_id) return null;

        $caption = $this->v($rec['caption'] ?? $rec['title'] ?? null);
        $url = $this->v($rec['url'] ?? $rec['link'] ?? null);
        $date = $this->v($rec['posted_date'] ?? $rec['date'] ?? $rec['published_date'] ?? null);
        $time = $this->v($rec['posted_time'] ?? $rec['time'] ?? null);

        $views = $this->toInt($rec['views'] ?? $rec['play_count'] ?? 0);
        $likes = $this->toInt($rec['likes'] ?? $rec['like_count'] ?? 0);
        $comments = $this->toInt($rec['comments'] ?? $rec['comment_count'] ?? 0);
        $shares = $this->toInt($rec['shares'] ?? $rec['share_count'] ?? 0);
        $saves = $this->toInt($rec['saves'] ?? $rec['save_count'] ?? 0);

        return [
            'platform' => 'tiktok',
            'platform_post_id' => $post_id,
            'post_url' => $url,
            'post_type' => 'video',
            'topic' => null,
            'caption' => $caption,
            'hashtags' => null,
            'posted_date' => $date,
            'posted_time' => $time,
            'views' => $views,
            'likes' => $likes,
            'comments' => $comments,
            'shares' => $shares,
            'saves' => $saves,
            'reach' => 0,
            'impressions' => 0,
            'engagement_rate' => 0,
            'internal_notes' => null,
            'snapshot_date' => $this->v($rec['snapshot_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d'))
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Import a batch of mapped rows - inserts posts, resolves IDs, inserts metrics, handles hashtags.
     *
     * This method optimizes database operations by:
     * - Using multi-row INSERT for posts table
     * - Resolving all post IDs in a single query
     * - Using multi-row INSERT for metrics_history
     * - Processing hashtags in batch at the end
     *
     * @param \mysqli $conn Database connection
     * @param array $batch Array of mapped rows from mapContentTrackerRow/mapTikTokExportRow
     * @return array{processed: int, skipped: int} Count of processed and skipped rows
     */
    private function importBatch(\mysqli $conn, array $batch): array {
        if (empty($batch)) {
            return ['processed' => 0, 'skipped' => 0];
        }

        $processed = 0;
        $hashtagsToProcess = []; // Collect hashtags for batch processing

        // === Step 1: Batch INSERT posts using dedicated method ===
        $this->insertPostsBatch($conn, $batch);

        // === Step 2: Resolve post IDs in bulk using optimized tuple IN syntax ===
        $postIdMap = $this->resolvePostIdsBatch($conn, $batch);

        // === Step 3: Build metrics rows for batch INSERT ===
        $metricsRows = [];

        foreach ($batch as $mapped) {
            $key = $mapped['platform'] . '|' . $mapped['platform_post_id'];
            $postId = $postIdMap[$key] ?? null;

            if ($postId) {
                $metricsRows[] = [
                    'post_id' => $postId,
                    'views' => $mapped['views'],
                    'likes' => $mapped['likes'],
                    'comments' => $mapped['comments'],
                    'shares' => $mapped['shares'],
                    'saves' => $mapped['saves'],
                    'reach' => $mapped['reach'],
                    'impressions' => $mapped['impressions'],
                    'snapshot_date' => $mapped['snapshot_date']
                ];

                // Collect hashtags for batch processing
                if (!empty($mapped['hashtags'])) {
                    $hashtagsToProcess[] = [
                        'post_id' => $postId,
                        'platform' => $mapped['platform'],
                        'hashtags' => $mapped['hashtags'],
                        'views' => $mapped['views'],
                        'likes' => $mapped['likes']
                    ];
                }

                $processed++;
            }
        }

        // Insert metrics history in batch using dedicated method
        $this->insertMetricsHistoryBatch($conn, $metricsRows);

        // === Step 4: Process hashtags in batch ===
        $this->processHashtagsBatch($conn, $hashtagsToProcess);

        return ['processed' => $processed, 'skipped' => count($batch) - $processed];
    }

    /**
     * Collect hashtags from batch - extract all unique hashtags with aggregated metrics.
     *
     * Parses hashtag strings from batch data and builds two structures:
     * 1. Aggregated hashtag metrics for upsert into hashtag_performance
     * 2. Post-hashtag links for insert into post_hashtags junction table
     *
     * @param array $hashtagsData Array of ['post_id', 'platform', 'hashtags', 'views', 'likes']
     * @return array{aggregates: array, links: array} Hashtag aggregates and post-hashtag links
     */
    private function collectHashtagsFromBatch(array $hashtagsData): array {
        if (empty($hashtagsData)) {
            return ['aggregates' => [], 'links' => []];
        }

        // Collect all unique hashtags with their aggregated metrics
        $hashtagAggregates = []; // [platform|hashtag] => [hashtag, platform, posts, views, likes]
        $postHashtagLinks = [];   // [[post_id, hashtag, platform], ...]

        foreach ($hashtagsData as $item) {
            // Parse hashtags (comma or space separated, with or without #)
            $hashtags = preg_split('/[,\s]+/', $item['hashtags']);
            $hashtags = array_filter($hashtags, function($h) { return strlen(trim($h)) > 0; });

            foreach ($hashtags as $hashtag) {
                $hashtag = ltrim(trim($hashtag), '#');
                if (strlen($hashtag) === 0) continue;

                $key = $item['platform'] . '|' . $hashtag;

                // Aggregate metrics for this hashtag
                if (!isset($hashtagAggregates[$key])) {
                    $hashtagAggregates[$key] = [
                        'hashtag' => $hashtag,
                        'platform' => $item['platform'],
                        'posts' => 0,
                        'views' => 0,
                        'likes' => 0
                    ];
                }

                $hashtagAggregates[$key]['posts']++;
                $hashtagAggregates[$key]['views'] += $item['views'];
                $hashtagAggregates[$key]['likes'] += $item['likes'];

                // Collect post-hashtag link
                $postHashtagLinks[] = [
                    'post_id' => $item['post_id'],
                    'hashtag' => $hashtag,
                    'platform' => $item['platform']
                ];
            }
        }

        return [
            'aggregates' => $hashtagAggregates,
            'links' => $postHashtagLinks
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Link posts to hashtags in batch using INSERT IGNORE into post_hashtags junction table.
     *
     * Efficiently inserts multiple post-hashtag links at once using multi-row
     * INSERT IGNORE. The IGNORE clause handles duplicate entries gracefully,
     * allowing the method to be called multiple times for the same data without
     * causing errors or duplicate rows.
     *
     * @param \mysqli $conn Database connection
     * @param array $postHashtagLinks Array of link data from collectHashtagsFromBatch()
     *                                 Each element: ['post_id' => int, 'hashtag' => string, 'platform' => string]
     * @param array $hashtagIdMap Associative array mapping "platform|hashtag" => hashtag_id (int)
     * @return int Number of rows affected (newly inserted links)
     */
    private function linkPostHashtagsBatch(\mysqli $conn, array $postHashtagLinks, array $hashtagIdMap): int {
        if (empty($postHashtagLinks) || empty($hashtagIdMap)) {
            return 0;
        }

        // Build link rows using hashtag ID map
        $linkRows = [];
        foreach ($postHashtagLinks as $link) {
            $key = $link['platform'] . '|' . $link['hashtag'];
            $hashtagId = $hashtagIdMap[$key] ?? null;
            if ($hashtagId) {
                $linkRows[] = [
                    'post_id' => (int)$link['post_id'],
                    'hashtag_id' => (int)$hashtagId
                ];
            }
        }

        if (empty($linkRows)) {
            return 0;
        }

        // Build multi-row INSERT for post_hashtags junction table
        $linkColumns = ['post_id', 'hashtag_id'];
        $linkData = $this->buildMultiRowInsertSql('post_hashtags', $linkColumns, $linkRows);

        if (empty($linkData['sql'])) {
            return 0;
        }

        // Replace INSERT with INSERT IGNORE to handle duplicate entries gracefully
        $sql = str_replace('INSERT INTO', 'INSERT IGNORE INTO', $linkData['sql']);

        $affectedRows = 0;
        $stmt = $conn->prepare($sql);
        if ($stmt) {
            if (!empty($linkData['params'])) {
                $stmt->bind_param($linkData['types'], ...$linkData['params']);
            }
            $stmt->execute();
            $affectedRows = $stmt->affected_rows;
            $stmt->close();
        }

        return $affectedRows;
    }

    /**
     * Upsert hashtags in batch to hashtag_performance table.
     *
     * Efficiently inserts or updates multiple hashtags at once using multi-row
     * INSERT ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE. On duplicate, increments totals rather
     * than replacing them, preserving cumulative metrics across imports.
     *
     * @param \mysqli $conn Database connection
     * @param array $hashtagAggregates Array of aggregated hashtag data from collectHashtagsFromBatch()
     *                                  Each element: ['hashtag', 'platform', 'posts', 'views', 'likes']
     * @return array Associative array mapping "platform|hashtag" => hashtag_id (int)
     */
    private function upsertHashtagsBatch(\mysqli $conn, array $hashtagAggregates): array {
        if (empty($hashtagAggregates)) {
            return [];
        }

        // Prepare rows for batch insert
        $hashtagColumns = ['hashtag', 'platform', 'total_posts', 'total_views', 'total_likes', 'last_used'];
        $hashtagRows = [];

        foreach ($hashtagAggregates as $agg) {
            $hashtagRows[] = [
                'hashtag' => $agg['hashtag'],
                'platform' => $agg['platform'],
                'total_posts' => $agg['posts'],
                'total_views' => $agg['views'],
                'total_likes' => $agg['likes'],
                'last_used' => date('Y-m-d')
            ];
        }

        // Build multi-row INSERT with ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
        // Uses increment expressions to add to existing totals rather than replace
        $hashtagData = $this->buildMultiRowInsertSql(
            'hashtag_performance',
            $hashtagColumns,
            $hashtagRows,
            [],
            [
                'total_posts' => 'total_posts + VALUES(total_posts)',
                'total_views' => 'total_views + VALUES(total_views)',
                'total_likes' => 'total_likes + VALUES(total_likes)',
                'last_used' => 'CURDATE()'
            ]
        );

        // Execute the batch upsert
        if (!empty($hashtagData['sql'])) {
            $stmt = $conn->prepare($hashtagData['sql']);
            if ($stmt && !empty($hashtagData['params'])) {
                $stmt->bind_param($hashtagData['types'], ...$hashtagData['params']);
                $stmt->execute();
                $stmt->close();
            }
        }

        // Retrieve all hashtag IDs in a single query using OR conditions
        // This is necessary because INSERT ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE doesn't return IDs for updated rows
        $hashtagIdMap = [];
        $placeholders = [];
        $params = [];
        $types = '';

        foreach ($hashtagAggregates as $agg) {
            $placeholders[] = "(hashtag = ? AND platform = ?)";
            $params[] = $agg['hashtag'];
            $params[] = $agg['platform'];
            $types .= 'ss';
        }

        $query = "SELECT id, hashtag, platform FROM hashtag_performance WHERE " . implode(' OR ', $placeholders);
        $stmt = $conn->prepare($query);
        if ($stmt) {
            $stmt->bind_param($types, ...$params);
            $stmt->execute();
            $result = $stmt->get_result();
            while ($row = $result->fetch_assoc()) {
                $key = $row['platform'] . '|' . $row['hashtag'];
                $hashtagIdMap[$key] = (int)$row['id'];
            }
            $stmt->close();
        }

        return $hashtagIdMap;
    }

    /**
     * Process hashtags in batch - replaces the legacy per-row processHashtags() method.
     *
     * Orchestrates hashtag batch processing by:
     * 1. Collecting unique hashtags with aggregated metrics via collectHashtagsFromBatch()
     * 2. Upserting to hashtag_performance table via upsertHashtagsBatch()
     * 3. Linking posts to hashtags in junction table via linkPostHashtagsBatch()
     *
     * This batch approach reduces database queries from ~3 per hashtag per post
     * to just 3 queries per entire batch (collect, upsert, link), providing
     * significant performance improvements for imports with many hashtags.
     *
     * @param \mysqli $conn Database connection
     * @param array $hashtagsData Array of ['post_id', 'platform', 'hashtags', 'views', 'likes']
     */
    private function processHashtagsBatch(\mysqli $conn, array $hashtagsData): void {
        if (empty($hashtagsData)) {
            return;
        }

        // Step 1: Collect all unique hashtags with their aggregated metrics
        // This parses hashtag strings and builds aggregate + link data structures
        $collected = $this->collectHashtagsFromBatch($hashtagsData);
        $hashtagAggregates = $collected['aggregates'];
        $postHashtagLinks = $collected['links'];

        if (empty($hashtagAggregates)) {
            return;
        }

        // Step 2: Batch upsert hashtag_performance and get hashtag IDs
        // Uses multi-row INSERT ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE with increment expressions
        $hashtagIdMap = $this->upsertHashtagsBatch($conn, $hashtagAggregates);

        // Step 3: Batch insert post_hashtags using dedicated method
        // Uses INSERT IGNORE for duplicate handling
        $this->linkPostHashtagsBatch($conn, $postHashtagLinks, $hashtagIdMap);
    }

    /**
     * Import CSV file - auto-detects format
     *
     * Uses batch processing pattern for improved performance:
     * - Collects rows into batches of BATCH_SIZE (default: 100)
     * - Calls importBatch() when batch is full
     * - Processes remaining rows at end of file
     * - For large files (>10k rows), commits every CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE rows (default: 5000)
     *   to prevent transaction timeouts and reduce memory pressure
     */
    public function import(array $file): array {
        if (($file['error'] ?? UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) !== UPLOAD_ERR_OK) {
            return ['processed' => 0, 'skipped' => 0, 'error' => 'Upload mislukt'];
        }

        $tmp = $file['tmp_name'];
        $processed = 0;
        $skipped = 0;

        $conn = $this->db->conn();

        // Estimate row count for large file detection (>10k rows threshold)
        // Uses file size / avg row size heuristic to avoid full file scan
        $fileSize = filesize($tmp);
        $isLargeFile = $fileSize > 500000; // ~500KB, roughly 10k rows at 50 bytes/row avg

        $conn->begin_transaction();

        // Track rows processed since last chunk commit (for large files)
        $chunkRowsProcessed = 0;

        try {
            // Open CSV
            if (($fh = fopen($tmp, 'r')) === false) {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Kan CSV niet openen');
            }

            // Read and normalize header
            $header = fgetcsv($fh);
            if (!$header) throw new \RuntimeException('Lege CSV');
            $header = $this->normalizeHeader($header);

            // Detect format
            $format = $this->detectFormat($header);
            if ($format === 'unknown') {
                throw new \RuntimeException('Onbekend CSV formaat. Ondersteunde formaten: TikTok export, content_tracker_enhanced.csv');
            }

            // Batch processing - uses class constants for configuration
            $batch = [];

            // Process rows - collect into batches
            while (($row = fgetcsv($fh)) !== false) {
                if (count($row) !== count($header)) {
                    $skipped++;
                    continue;
                }

                $rec = array_combine($header, $row);

                // Map row based on format
                $mapped = null;
                if ($format === 'content_tracker') {
                    $mapped = $this->mapContentTrackerRow($rec);
                } elseif ($format === 'tiktok_export') {
                    $mapped = $this->mapTikTokExportRow($rec);
                }

                if (!$mapped) {
                    $skipped++;
                    continue;
                }

                // Add to batch
                $batch[] = $mapped;

                // Process batch when full
                if (count($batch) >= self::BATCH_SIZE) {
                    $result = $this->importBatch($conn, $batch);
                    $processed += $result['processed'];
                    $skipped += $result['skipped'];
                    $chunkRowsProcessed += count($batch);
                    $batch = []; // Reset batch

                    // Chunked transaction commits for large files
                    // Commit and restart transaction every CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE rows
                    // to prevent transaction timeouts and reduce memory pressure
                    if ($isLargeFile && $chunkRowsProcessed >= self::CHUNK_COMMIT_SIZE) {
                        $conn->commit();
                        $conn->begin_transaction();
                        $chunkRowsProcessed = 0;
                    }
                }
            }

            // Process remaining rows in the final batch
            if (!empty($batch)) {
                $result = $this->importBatch($conn, $batch);
                $processed += $result['processed'];
                $skipped += $result['skipped'];
            }

            fclose($fh);

            // Log import
            $fn = $file['name'] ?? 'upload.csv';
            $imp = $conn->prepare("
                INSERT INTO import_history (filename, platform, import_type, rows_imported, rows_skipped, imported_at)
                VALUES (?, 'multi', ?, ?, ?, NOW())
            ");
            $imp->bind_param("ssii", $fn, $format, $processed, $skipped);
            $imp->execute();

            $conn->commit();
            return [
                'processed' => $processed,
                'skipped' => $skipped,
                'format' => $format
            ];
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            $conn->rollback();
            return [
                'processed' => $processed,
                'skipped' => $skipped,
                'error' => $e->getMessage()
            ];
        }
    }
